text: And when we say old friends,
we mean friends that we've had a long time,

text: particularly since we were children.

text: So Phil, do you have many old friends?

text: as much as I should.

As you get older, you move away,

text: So I don't often see people
that are very old friends.

text: Yeah, I do.
I mean, luckily for myself,
we don't live very far away.

zh: 所以保持联系比较容易。
zh_hant: 所以保持聯絡比較容易。

text: And by staying in touch, we mean kind of keeping

zh_hant: 保持聯絡，我們指的是保持那種

text: that contact.
So I do have a couple of friendship groups.
We have group chats
where we kind of keep
in touch with each other there,
and we plan meetings.
Although we find that when we plan to meet each other,
zh: 虽然我们发现，当计划见面的时候，
zh_hant: 雖然我們發現，當計劃見面的時候，

text: we will then plan to meet
each other the next time months
in advance,
months before we meet, because yeah, it is difficult when you.

text: are older and you get busy,
how often do you see your old friends?

text: it sounds like you stay in touch quite a lot.

text: yeah, we do, we stay in touch a lot over, like I said,

once every couple of months, if we really try.

text: so yeah, it is easier for us to meet up.
zh: 所以是的，我们见面比较容易。
zh_hant: 所以是的，我們見面比較容易。

text: so when was the last time that you saw one of your old friends?

text: it was probably sometime last year, I think,

zh_hant: 大概是去年某個時候吧，我覺得，

text: but yeah, I probably only a couple of times a year,

text: I think, I'd see old friends.
And have you lost touch with any of your old friends?

zh_hant: 那你有沒有和某些老朋友失去聯絡？

text: So to lose touch is to lose that contact

text: that you have with them.
Yes, I think I have.

text: because it's not like you have an argument,

text: You just.

text: If I saw those people again,

zh_hant: 也許我會重新和他們聯絡，但，嗯，

zh_hant: 肯定有些我以前認識的人

so yeah, I've definitely lost touch with some people.

text: So do you
think your friendship groups
have kind of changed
as you've grown older,
then, if you've lost touch with some old friends, you have newer friends now?

text: What has changed a lot is I have a lot

text: more friends
who are families who have children

you have so much in common with people

text: in the same situation, and your children do.

text: you're going to spend a lot of time together.

text: I see, so that's where we're quite different,

don't have families,

text: we learned in this episode,
starting with old friend.

text: And that's a friend that you've known for a very long time.
So we had this idea of being in touch

text: with someone, with a friend.

zh_hant: 如果你和某人保持聯絡，

text: And if you are in touch with someone,

zh_hant: 意思是你經常見他們，經常和他們說話。

text: it means that you see them often, you speak to them often.
zh: 如果你和某人keep in touch，
zh_hant: 如果你和某人keep in touch，

text: So if you keep in touch with someone,
zh: 意思是你继续做这些事情，
zh_hant: 意思是你繼續做這些事情，

text: it means you continue to do those things
even after a long time.
zh: 如果你和某人失去了联系，
zh_hant: 如果你和某人失去了聯絡，

text: that means that you don't see or speak to them anymore.

zh_hant: 意思就是重新開始見他們或和他們說話。

text: That is to start seeing them or speaking to them again.

zh_hant: 如果你和某人保持朋友關係，

For example,
